name: account_functions
query: SELECT DISTINCT account, root(account) AS r1, root(account, 2) AS r2, root(account, 9) AS r9, parent(account) AS p, leaf(account) AS l, parent(root(account)) AS p_of_root WHERE account ~ 'BofA|^Equity' ORDER BY account
notes: root(a) defaults to 1 component; root(a, n) with n beyond the depth returns a; parent of a top-level account is '' (empty string, not NULL).
